cards.direction_or_boundary: Zero-field branch separation decreases strongly with temperature and is over an order of magnitude larger at 300 K than 870 K.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Strict cross-zero branch segmentation with branch-preserving systematic thinning, local linear/quadratic zero estimators, and low-field branch-gap windows.
cards.object: Three complete magnetic field scans with strict cross-zero branch segmentation.
cards.one_liner: Branch-separated low-field magnetic response is much larger at 300 K than at 860–870 K.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A replicate full scan supports the relationship if its predeclared 300 K branch separation exceeds the 870 K separation under every admitted zero estimator; equality or reversal under any admitted estimator is failure.

cards.scope: One sample source; branch separation is evidence of loop-like response, not proof of a universal material mechanism.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports magnetically ordered behavior at ambient conditions and a high-temperature boundary.
target_alignment.paper_location: Bulk magnetometry Results and temperature-dependent source-data scans.

cards.direction_or_boundary: Opposing sweep branches differ at zero coordinate and enclose a nonzero signed area after linear detrending.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: The non-crossing initial segment is excluded; one full cross-zero sweep and the terminal return branch with a measured zero endpoint are retained, with branch-preserving thinning and closed-path area perturbations.
cards.object: Complete raw current-voltage-like and corrected switching sequences.
cards.one_liner: Both supplied electrical sequences contain direction-dependent branch separation and nonzero loop area.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A repeat sequence supports the relationship only if its full crossing and terminal zero-return branches retain corrected separation above 0.30 and raw separation above 10 under branch-preserving thinning; either threshold failing is failure. A non-crossing initial segment is excluded.

cards.scope: Loop-like electrical evidence from one sample; leakage and baseline alternatives remain possible.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports switchable polarization under an external field.
target_alignment.paper_location: Electrical switching Results and source-data sequences.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
